{{Quote|&hellip;it was an Imperial ship, of outdated design. It jumped in-system and began firing. Then the landing parties came. Purebloods dressed like savages, butchering my men&hellip; they're coming for me now&mdash;|Senu's last transmission|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
'''Senu''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Lord Senu's fortress|His fortress]] was attacked by [[Darth Ikoral]] and an army of savage, pureblood Sith. A target for the army's xenophobic crusade, Senu was unable to stop the renegade Sith Lord and was thus [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the attack.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
